visual_findings: Scanner RGB colors are plausible in all three. The kidney TCGA-UZ-A9PO-01Z-00-DX1_4 field has sparse bright virtual-DAPI spots amid blood-rich tissue, but the field-level AUC is only 0.641 and nuclear boundary contrast is 0.048. The prostate TCGA-G9-6499-01Z-00-DX1-3 field has a visible broad haze across a sparse blood-rich field (AUC 0.619, contrast 0.036). The dense kidney TCGA-UZ-A9PU-01Z-00-DX1_1 field shows virtual DAPI merging adjacent nuclei and diffuse CD68 (AUC 0.686, contrast 0.014). All remain excluded; none has protein-specific measured truth.
scope: Preview-scale inspection of cases 69-71 from an active 93-case CPU bundle; no post-hoc QC threshold change.
